A real integration connects the site more directly, so things like deposit payments and system syncing can be built around that setup. A basic site without the integration is usually in that two thousand to three thousand dollar range, depending on how many pages and what you need on it. If you want, I can put together a free homepage mockup so you can see the direction before deciding.
Alright, two to three thousand for a basic site. A free mockup, huh? How does that work?
You review it and reply to the email only if it's useful.
Okay, that sounds good. So, what do you need from me for that?
Best email?
It's [REDACTED_EMAIL].
Just to confirm, [REDACTED_EMAIL] - is that right?
Yeah, that's right.
Great, I'll send it there by the end of the day.
Okay, great. Thanks.
Take care.
